summary: Created and read back the requested post through live EmDash MCP. It remains an unpublished draft.

checks.result: Passed. Existing post data exposed the collection field names title, content, and excerpt.

checks.command: MCP content_create(collection=posts, slug=kickoff-cms-source, data={title, content, excerpt})
checks.result: Passed. The first attempt using field body was rejected as unknown; corrected to the observed content field. The successful create returned status draft.
Passed. Readback confirmed title, excerpt, requested body text in content, slug kickoff-cms-source, status draft, publishedAt null, and scheduledAt null.

cms.permissionExplanation: The create tool defaults new content to draft; its schema says setting an explicit status requires publish permission. Publishing makes a draft live, so no publish action was taken. The current MCP credential could create the draft, but schema_get_collection was rejected because it lacks schema:read. Existing content reads were sufficient to identify the accepted title, content, and excerpt fields.
